issue: Streaming-safe profiling of large Fitbit JSON files
decision: Profile schema without loading >100 MB files wholly into memory.
impact: Blocks only parsing paths that require unverified structure.

issue: Timestamp and timezone conventions across Fitbit streams
decision: Preserve raw timestamps; do not normalize or align until verified.
impact: Blocks timestamp normalization and time-based joins.

issue: Units and definitions for Fitbit and structured reporting fields
decision: Preserve source values and labels; mark units unknown where not documented.
impact: Blocks unsupported unit conversion and derived metrics.

issue: Participant file coverage and completeness
decision: Inventory participant/file coverage and report gaps.
impact: Blocks claims of complete cohort coverage.

issue: Official license, attribution and non-commercial terms
decision: Verify source terms before redistribution or deployment.
impact: Blocks redistribution or deployment decisions requiring rights clearance.

issue: Full schema and row validation for all 15 wide-format files
decision: Validate each file independently before transformation.
impact: Blocks transformation of any file whose schema is not verified.

issue: Player coverage and identifier completeness
decision: Preserve player IDs exactly; report coverage and gaps.
impact: Blocks unsupported player-level completeness claims.

issue: Date format and locale validation
decision: Preserve raw date strings; parse only after full-file validation.
impact: Blocks date normalization and date-based joins.

issue: Session JSON structure and complete traversal
decision: Profile and validate JSON structure before extracting sessions.
impact: Blocks parsing of unverified structures.

issue: Wellness scales and units
decision: Preserve values and labels; do not reinterpret scales.
impact: Blocks scale normalization and cross-source comparison.

issue: Training-load formula definitions and windows
decision: Preserve source metrics without recalculation.
impact: Blocks recalculation or reinterpretation.

issue: Game-performance semantics and event timestamp formats
decision: Preserve source fields and raw timestamps pending documentation.
impact: Blocks semantic recoding and time-based event alignment.

issue: Sensor-axis and vm definitions and units
decision: Preserve raw channels; mark units/semantics unverified.
impact: Blocks unit conversion and interpretation-dependent features.

issue: Sampling, epoch, timezone and study start-date rules
decision: Keep actigraphy and daily responses separate; preserve raw time fields.
impact: Blocks temporal alignment and time-derived joins.

issue: Unnamed index field semantics
decision: Retain as source_row_index; do not treat as timestamp.
impact: Blocks timestamp interpretation of the index.

issue: Sleep and caffeine units/definitions
decision: Preserve source values and field names without conversion.
impact: Blocks unit conversion and derived intake/sleep metrics.

issue: Questionnaire scales and ASBQ scoring key
decision: Preserve item responses; do not calculate composite scores.
impact: Blocks questionnaire composite scoring.

issue: Reconcile 21 actigraphy IDs against 22 questionnaire IDs
decision: Keep tables separate until full-set uniqueness and coverage are verified.
impact: Blocks participant-level joins.

issue: Reconcile inventory discrepancy: 2,475 files/2.98 GB vs 1,122 files/3.19 GB
decision: Repeat inventory with documented root, exclusions and hashing rules.
impact: Blocks claims of final inventory completeness.

issue: Dataset provenance and license/attribution
decision: Verify source documentation and reuse terms.
impact: Blocks redistribution or deployment decisions requiring rights clearance.

issue: E4, earbuds, Muse, Zephyr and VO2 schemas and units
decision: Preserve raw modality files; parse only using verified schemas.
impact: Blocks parsing/conversion of unverified modality files.

issue: Device sampling rates and timestamp semantics
decision: Preserve raw timestamps and modality-specific cadence; do not resample or synchronize.
impact: Blocks synchronization and resampling.

issue: Zephyr binary .dat/.hed format and metadata semantics
decision: Preserve binary files unchanged; do not decode in baseline preprocessing.
impact: Blocks Zephyr binary decoding.

issue: Fitbit and Apple Watch participant mapping
decision: Keep shared exports unassigned until a verified mapping exists.
impact: Blocks participant-level assignment and joins.

issue: Questionnaire scoring keys and composite definitions
decision: Preserve item-level responses; do not calculate composites.
impact: Blocks questionnaire composite scoring.
